mods.name: Hotbar Item Replacer
mods.description: Swaps used/broken Items in your hotbar for new ones of the same type

releases.notes:
Most important feature updates:

- Added a settings GUI
- Chosen options now persist and are saved locally

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MConfuse/HotbarItemReplacer/compare/v0.3-beta.1...mc-1.19.4-v0.4-beta.1

The first iteration of ~~AutoItemSwitch~~ HotbarItemReplacer (Renamed the project in commit v0.3.1 BETA)

Features:
When an item breaks/a stack is used up (e.g.: food/blocks), it will be automatically replaced with an item from your inventory following these rules:

- New item has to be in your inventory, no cheating!
- The new item will be replaced by an equivalent block, or for tools and weapons an item that has the same material. If there are no items of the same material, it will search for from best to worst material (Vanilla material order: Netherite, Diamond, Iron, Stone, Gold/Wood), taking into account the efficiency/sharpness/silk touch enchantments, always equipping the best item available first.
- If a tool is enchanted with _Silk Touch_, only tools with silk touch will be equipped, even if there are non-silk touch tools available!
- When a stack of food is used up, it will first search for another stack of the same kind of food, if none are found, it will choose the most nutritious (most hunger bars filled) food first

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MConfuse/AutoItemReplace/commits/v0.3-beta.1
